text:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — planning final release cutover in ~2h (v2.4.2). Need a fast dep-lock check, green-sweep, and a last changelog nudge. Can folks confirm they have no outstanding merges to release/*?
Jonah Li: On it. I see one outstanding dep bump (lib-http 3.1.0 -> 3.2.0) on release/v2.4.2-deps. I'll either pin or merge depending on CI. Kicking a premerge run now.
deploy-bot: CI queued: premerge-checks for release/v2.4.2-deps (pipeline #1287).
Priya Shah: Changelog PR is ready (PR #462). Needs a quick review for the migration note. @Anil can you skim the upgrade notes?
Anil Kumar: Will review in 10. Also flagging the flaky test we hit yesterday: tests/integration/test_logging_rot13.py — fails intermittently on mac-latest with socket timeout. Putting a note on flaky-hunt board.
Jonah Li: Re: dep bump — if premerge fails, I'll revert to 3.1.0 and open a follow-up post-release. Keeping the lockfile change gated until we get a green.
ci-bot: premerge-checks pipeline started (job: unit, job: smoke, job: integration). Logs: https://ci.example/redwood/1287
Maya Patel: Good approach. If unit+smoke pass, let's run a targeted green-sweep for integration and e2e groups. Command: `scripts/ci/green-sweep.sh --groups=integration,e2e --parallel=4`
Priya Shah: Also, reminder: the changelog needs to call out the Dedicated config flag rename (keep snippet in PR). I added the code block in the description.
Anil Kumar: Quick note on flaky: snippet from failing log —
``` 
E 2025-03-12 09:42:11,233 connection.py:92 socket.timeout: timed out after 5.0s while reading
-- captured stderr --
requests.exceptions.ReadTimeout: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='api.internal', port=443): Read timed out.
```
I'll add a conservative retry in the test harness and re-run.
Jonah Li: Premerge results: unit & smoke green, integration failing on the logging_rot13 test (same flaky). Rerunning integration with focused rerun.
deploy-bot: Rerun queued: integration (rerun #2) for pipeline 1287.
Maya Patel: If integration still flakes, let's do a targeted skip+ticket workflow: skip test with TODO and open a follow-up issue linking the job logs and stack trace. We want release on schedule but not carry unstable tests.
Priya Shah: Agreed. I'll prep the changelog release notes and mark the PR as release-ready once the integration sweep is green or the flaky is triaged.
Anil Kumar: Integration rerun passed after test harness tweak (increased read timeout). I pushed a tiny test-fix commit to the release branch to stabilize.
Jonah Li: Lockfile updated and merged to release/v2.4.2. Pinned lib-http 3.1.0 for this cut due to perf regression in 3.2.0 — will follow up post-release.
Maya Patel: Excellent. Final checklist: 1) lockfile merged (✅) 2) changelog PR approved (Priya to confirm) 3) green-sweep integration & e2e (✅) 4) tag and cut release 20m before cutover.
Priya Shah: Changelog approved and merged. Tagging release notes with highlights and migration note.
ci-bot: Full green-sweep completed for release/v2.4.2 (pipeline 1290) — all jobs passed.
Maya Patel: Perfect — thanks all. I'll start the cut and post the tag. If anyone sees a last-minute failure ping here and we can triage quickly. :thumbsup:
